review_scope: Read-only source and completed actual R1 A-events artifacts; no new GPU run or CPU suite executed by this review

required_report_definitions.forward_cuda_events: Same current-stream elapsed between events around the unchanged original network call; includes possible host launch/idle gaps. It is not pure isolated kernel time or an uninstrumented latency claim.
required_report_definitions.wall_sections: Host perf_counter_ns elapsed; include event record/creation and blocking inside scope. Deferred final-event synchronization is measured separately at step end. Nested scopes overlap and cannot be summed as exclusive components.
required_report_definitions.observation_to_command: Observation-construction start captured for current input through first original controller software joint-effort-target submission callback; neither physical actuator execution nor device command completion.
required_report_definitions.wrapper_admission: Earlier software wrapper-entry admission timestamp; it is distinct from first effort-target callback.
required_report_definitions.available_observation_to_command: Observation available timestamp through earlier wrapper admission; does not include observation construction or final effort-target computation.
required_report_definitions.command_intervals: Consecutive first-effort-target host timestamps. These include full intervening physics, controller, diagnostics, parity work, synchronization, reset work and logging; not inverse network-forward time.
required_report_definitions.control_loop: Command-to-command wall interval recorded per decision, not a bare network interval. Selected n=130 contains warmup-boundary interval, while wholly postwarmup command intervals n=129.
required_report_definitions.h2d: No policy H2D transfer occurs: observations already live on GPU. cpu_gpu_transfer_h2d is an empty host scope placeholder; its small wall overhead must not be presented as actual transfer latency.
required_report_definitions.d2h: Diagnostic tensor .cpu().tolist conversion scope, including host preparation and potential synchronization; not a policy-path input transfer or isolated DMA benchmark. Additional snapshot/logging overhead is covered by command intervals.
required_report_definitions.real_time_factor: Summary computes nominal policy simulated time (15Hz interval per record) divided by aligned wall intervals; excludes auxiliary reset physics advancement. Label nominal policy-time real-time factor rather than total simulator-time factor.
required_report_definitions.a_stage_totals: Controller-target and physics wall summaries aggregate multiple substeps per decision; raw event rows retain per-invocation data. Extra reset calls are included in physics scopes.
required_report_definitions.off_mode: StepProfiler off makes no profiler clock/CUDA calls, but I2 adapter still records diagnostics and outer host timestamps. Events-off with diagnostics is not an entirely uninstrumented runtime.

default_behavior_preservation.profiler_none: FrozenPolicy.infer optional profiler=None wraps original three stages in nullcontext; all computations, checks, RNG consumption, clones and model call remain in original order.
default_behavior_preservation.default_i1_runtime: Without --i2, no Telemetry adapter is constructed. Default seed/count and original action/EMA/controller/success path remain available.
default_behavior_preservation.evidence: Prior CPU probe parity tests and actual R1 A-events exact numerical/RNG/RMS parity; no new test execution in this review.

fault_contract.scope: Synthetic CPU fake-clock software admission and validation. No actual runtime fault-injection, physical hold, real safety or hardware stop claim.
fault_contract.production_preregistered_policy: Late but fresh commands log only; >60s software observation age rejects. Clock starts at decision preparation, so inference_wall_ms is broader than bare neural forward.
fault_contract.stop_policy: CPU-tested stop request latch only; actual simulator stopping under injected deadline was not executed.
